page.title: What agents see
page.description: Choose which tools an agent gets. Each profile is its own address, so different agents can see different tools.

help.list: Every chosen tool is in the agent's list. Simple, but a big list uses more of its context.
help.search: The agent gets a search tool plus your pinned tools, and finds the rest when it needs them.
help.auto: Lists the tools while the list is small, and switches to search once it gets big.

empty.searchHint: Try a shorter search, or clear it with Esc.
empty.packsHint: Turn on a pack in Keys & packs to add tools.
empty.noProfilesBody: Create a profile to choose which tools an endpoint shows.

advanced.summary: Advanced: when auto switches to search
advanced.switchOver: Switch to search when the list is over

tree.label: Tools
tree.pinTitleOn: Always list this tool, even when the agent uses search
tree.pinTitleOff: Always listed, even when the agent uses search
tree.shortcutsBase: Arrow keys move, Space turns on or off, Enter opens a group
tree.shortcutsPin: , P pins a tool so it is always listed
tree.pinsNote: Pinned tools stay in the agent's list even when it uses search (at most {max}).

tokenBar.label: {total} tokens. Search turns on at {threshold}.
tokenBar.labelDirect: Listing every chosen tool would use {direct}.

preview.title: What the agent sees
preview.errorTitle: The preview could not be made

searchList.one: The agent's list has {count} tool: a search tool{pinned}.
searchList.other: The agent's list has {count} tools: a search tool{pinned}.

canFindAll.one: It can find all {count} tool through search.
canFindAll.other: It can find all {count} tools through search.

preview.savesTokens: That saves about {count} tokens compared with listing them all.

chosenList.one: {count} chosen tool, all in the agent's list.
chosenList.other: {count} chosen tools, all in the agent's list.

preview.autoNote: Auto switches to search above {tokens} tokens or {tools} tools.

discardDialog.title: Discard unsaved changes?
discardDialog.body: The changes to {name} are not saved yet. Discarding them cannot be undone.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {name}?
deleteDialog.bodyAfter: lose all its tools on their next request. This cannot be undone.

createDialog.description: A profile is a separate endpoint with its own tool selection. It starts empty: turn on the tools it should show.
createDialog.errUrl: The URL name must start with a letter and use 2 to 32 lowercase letters, digits or dashes.
createDialog.errExists: A profile with this URL name already exists.
createDialog.errLimit: This server has as many profiles as it supports. Delete one first.

toast.saved: {name} saved. Agents pick this up the next time they connect or refresh their tools.
toast.maxPins: At most {max} tools can be pinned.
